blurb: A six-wheeled troop carrier for six: a driver and a passenger in the cab, four standing on the flatbed, every rider shooting their own weapon

notes.model: Ironclad Vanguard (Meshy Community, CC0; the owner's Drive, Meshy_AI_Ironclad_Vanguard_1111000212_texture.glb; content/guns.json vehicles/troop_truck.glb, 2026-11-11): an armoured three-axle army truck, a closed cab ahead of an open flatbed, 5.6 m long, 2.79 m wide over the tires and 2.54 m tall. Its six tires are cut out as parts (wheel_*), so they spin, the front pair steers, and each rides a spring.
notes.half: Fitted to the whole truck, tires included (owner, 2026-11-11): 2.8 × 2.54 × 5.6 m.
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles): the cab, a closed shell (no seats of its own), from z 0.3 to the windscreen at 2.3, roof 2.3-2.5 m up; the two in it sit on cushions 1.2 m up at z 1.1, 0.45 m either side. The flatbed is 1.6 m up from z -0.1 to the tail at -2.8, 2.4 m wide, open overhead; four riders stand on it two by two (x ±0.55, z -0.9 and -2.0), like the Buggy's deck riders. No mounted gun.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height in the driver's seat, under the cab roof, behind the windscreen.
notes.vehicle: Wheeled heavy, from the Armored Rover (14 m/s, accel 7, turn 1.25, grip 0.38, mass 3.6): a little quicker (16 m/s, accel 8.5, turn 1.4), still heavy and grippy (grip 0.36, mass 3: it rams like the heavies and loses little in a crash); stiff truck springs on six wheels, barely loose at speed (drift 0.15).
